name: eradicate-survives
description: G8 (John 11:35): cart kills Lokier before he can take eradicate's head. cart follows his recording to 10.2 s, is at the Apartments window (teleported: this tests what eradicate does after, not cart's pathing) and sprays Lokier on Truck, killing him around 11 s. Lokier's recorded kill of eradicate (12.75 s) can't happen: eradicate's fate is gone, he goes LIVE for good (trigger fate) and plays the rest of the round as a normal T: on to B (the team's site), cover the plant, guard the bomb, fight the CTs he meets. Then cart plays his recording again.
